content.json:
ICO Security Operations Command Center

Every panel is one of six patterns. See docs/D2-recipes.md to add or change one.

parameters.name: Analyst
parameters.label: Assigned analyst
parameters.query:
union (print Value = "All"),
  (SecurityIncident
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IncidentNumber
| extend A = iff(isempty(tostring(Owner.assignedTo)), "Unassigned", tostring(Owner.assignedTo))
| distinct A
| order by A asc
   | project Value = tostring(A))
| project Value

parameters.name: Rule
parameters.label: Analytic rule
parameters.query:
union (print Value = "All"),
  (SecurityIncident
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IncidentNumber
| distinct Title
| order by Title asc
   | project Value = tostring(Title))
| project Value

parameters.name: Provider
parameters.label: Incident provider
parameters.query:
union (print Value = "All"),
  (SecurityIncident
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IncidentNumber
| mv-expand P = AdditionalData.alertProductNames to typeof(string)
| distinct P
| where isnotempty(P)
| order by P asc
   | project Value = tostring(P))
| project Value

parameters.name: User
parameters.label: User
parameters.query:
union (print Value = "All"),
  (SecurityAlert
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where isnotempty(CompromisedEntity)
| distinct CompromisedEntity
| order by CompromisedEntity asc
| take 500
   | project Value = tostring(CompromisedEntity))
| project Value

content.json:
Executive Command Center
SOC workload, current risk exposure and operational effectiveness at a glance.
Key metrics — All nine tiles honour the filters at the top of the page

content.query:
// Nine tiles from one query -- each union branch is recipe P1/P2.
let Base = SecurityIncident
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where Severity in ({Severity})
    | where "{IncidentStatus}" == "All" or Status == "{IncidentStatus}"
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IncidentNumber
    | extend AnalystName = iff(isempty(tostring(Owner.assignedTo)), "Unassigned", tostring(Owner.assignedTo))
    | where "{Analyst}" == "All" or AnalystName == "{Analyst}"
    | where "{Rule}" == "All" or Title == "{Rule}"
    | extend Provider = tostring(AdditionalData.alertProductNames)
    | where "{Provider}" == "All" or Provider has "{Provider}";
let RiskyUsers = toscalar(
    union isfuzzy=true (AADRiskyUsers | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
        | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by UserPrincipalName
        | where IsDeleted == false and RiskLevel == "high"
          and RiskState in ("atRisk", "confirmedCompromised")
        | summarize C = count()),
      (print C = 0) | summarize max(C));
union
  (Base | summarize Value = count()
     | extend Metric = "Total incidents", Context = "all statuses", Ord = 1),
  (Base | where Status != "Closed" | summarize Value = count()
     | extend Metric = "Open", Context = "not yet closed", Ord = 2),
  (Base | where Status != "Closed" and Severity == "High"
     | summarize Value = count()
     | extend Metric = "High severity open", Context = "open and high", Ord = 3),
  (Base | where Status != "Closed" and AnalystName == "Unassigned"
     | summarize Value = count()
     | extend Metric = "Unassigned", Context = "open, no owner", Ord = 4),
  (Base | where CreatedTime > ago(24h) | summarize Value = count()
     | extend Metric = "Created last 24h", Context = "new arrivals", Ord = 5),
  (Base | where Status == "Closed" | summarize Value = count()
     | extend Metric = "Closed", Context = "resolved in range", Ord = 6),
  (Base | where Status == "Closed" and isnotempty(ClosedTime)
     | extend Hrs = (ClosedTime - CreatedTime) / 1h
     | summarize Value = toint(round(avg(Hrs), 0))
     | extend Metric = "Mean time to resolve", Context = "hours, closed only", Ord = 7),
  (print Value = RiskyUsers
     | extend Metric = "High-risk users", Context = "Entra ID Protection", Ord = 8),
  (Base | summarize Value = dcount(Title)
     | extend Metric = "Rules generating incidents", Context = "distinct rules", Ord = 9)
| order by Ord asc
| project Metric, Value, Context
content.noDataMessage: No incidents match the current filters.

content.json: SLA breach tracking — Time to first touch against a per-severity target. Adjust the targets below to match your policy

content.query:
SecurityIncident
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Severity in ({Severity})
| where "{IncidentStatus}" == "All" or Status == "{IncidentStatus}"
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IncidentNumber
| extend AnalystName = iff(isempty(tostring(Owner.assignedTo)), "Unassigned", tostring(Owner.assignedTo))
| where "{Analyst}" == "All" or AnalystName == "{Analyst}"
| where "{Rule}" == "All" or Title == "{Rule}"
| extend Provider = tostring(AdditionalData.alertProductNames)
| where "{Provider}" == "All" or Provider has "{Provider}"
| extend AgeHours = (now() - CreatedTime) / 1h
| extend TargetHours = case(Severity == "High", {SlaHigh},
                            Severity == "Medium", {SlaMedium},
                            {SlaLow})
| extend ElapsedHours = iff(isnotempty(FirstModifiedTime),
    (FirstModifiedTime - CreatedTime) / 1h, AgeHours)
| extend SLA = iff(ElapsedHours > TargetHours, "BREACHED", "Within SLA")
| where SLA == "BREACHED"
| project IncidentNumber, Title, Severity, Status, Analyst = AnalystName,
          TargetHours, ElapsedHours = round(ElapsedHours, 1), SLA, CreatedTime
| order by ElapsedHours desc
| take 100
content.noDataMessage: No SLA breaches. Everything is within target.

content.json: These panels match on rule name (AlertName ↔ Title). Accurate enough for triage. Before anyone builds a business case on the numbers, switch to the AlertIds join in D2 recipe P6.

Identity Risk & UEBA Dashboard
Who is flagged as risky by Entra ID Protection, and who is behaving unusually according to UEBA.

Names are pseudonymised by default. The same person keeps the same handle, so cases stay trackable without real names on a leadership dashboard. Switch Identity display to Actual when you need to act on someone specific. Microsoft's own Purview Insider Risk Management pseudonymises by default for the same reason.
Data readiness — check first — Which sources are actually reporting. A missing source means the panels below it will be empty

content.query:
// Department and job title come from Entra ID user attributes.
// If coverage is low, every division breakdown reads 'Unmapped'.
BehaviorAnalytics
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize Rows = count(),
            WithDepartment = countif(isnotempty(tostring(UsersInsights.Department))),
            WithJobTitle = countif(isnotempty(tostring(UsersInsights.JobTitle)))
| extend DepartmentCoverage = strcat(tostring(iff(Rows > 0,
    round(100.0 * WithDepartment / Rows, 0), 0.0)), "%")
| extend JobTitleCoverage = strcat(tostring(iff(Rows > 0,
    round(100.0 * WithJobTitle / Rows, 0), 0.0)), "%")
| project Rows, DepartmentCoverage, JobTitleCoverage
content.noDataMessage: No BehaviorAnalytics data. Is UEBA enabled?

content.json: Geographic anomalies — Identities active from more than one distinct source location in the period

content.query:
// Geographic anomaly: one identity acting from several locations.
BehaviorAnalytics
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where isnotempty(SourceIPLocation) and isnotempty(UserPrincipalName)
| where "{User}" == "All" or UserPrincipalName has "{User}"
| extend Subject = iff("{IdentityDisplay}" == "Actual", UserPrincipalName, strcat("user-", substring(hash_sha256(UserPrincipalName), 0, 8)))
| summarize Locations = dcount(SourceIPLocation),
            SeenFrom = make_set(SourceIPLocation, 8),
            Priority = sum(InvestigationPriority) by Subject
| where Locations > 1
| order by Locations desc, Priority desc
| take 25
content.noDataMessage: No multi-location activity in range.

content.json: Users with multiple incident associations — Appearing in more than one incident is a stronger signal than any single alert

content.query:
// Recipe P6, with the exact AlertIds join rather than name matching.
let IncidentUsers =
    SecurityIncident
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | where Severity in ({Severity})
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IncidentNumber
    | mv-expand AlertId = AlertIds to typeof(string)
    | join kind=inner (
        SecurityAlert
        | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
        | where isnotempty(CompromisedEntity)
        | project SystemAlertId, CompromisedEntity, AlertName
      ) on $left.AlertId == $right.SystemAlertId;
IncidentUsers
| where "{User}" == "All" or CompromisedEntity has "{User}"
| summarize Incidents = dcount(IncidentNumber),
            Rules = dcount(AlertName),
            LastSeen = max(CreatedTime) by User = CompromisedEntity
| where Incidents > 1
| order by Incidents desc
| take 25
content.noDataMessage: No user appears in more than one incident in range.

content.json:
Two schema traps live on this tab. BehaviorAnalytics uses UsersInsights and SourceIPAddress (plural, capital P); Anomalies uses UserInsights and SourceIpAddress (singular, lower-case p). Copying a line between them fails silently. Also Tactics is a string, not an array — use split(), never mv-expand. See D3 § 15.

The two user panels join incidents to users via AlertIds, which is the accurate route — SecurityIncident has no user column of its own.
